# Release a prepared Node.js package

Use the package actions to publish prepared files and
[`ci-github-publish`](https://github.com/hoverkraft-tech/ci-github-publish/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.md)
for version planning and GitHub release notes.

Before packaging, commit the intended version and lockfile changes, check out that
source, configure Node.js and the project's package manager, and build the package.
The committed source, compiled output and tarball must contain the same version.
The [CI workflow](continuous-integration.md) can produce the build artifact; an
existing build job can also supply it.

## Package and publish

The following steps belong in a job after checkout and runtime setup. Replace
`<sha>` with the same supported `ci-github-nodejs` commit for both actions and
`needs.build.outputs.artifact-id` with the output of your artifact-producing job.
Set `build-artifact-path` to the artifact's extraction directory. For files already
prepared in the job, omit both artifact inputs.

```yaml
- name: Create package tarball
  id: package
  uses: hoverkraft-tech/ci-github-nodejs/actions/package/create@<sha>
  with:
    build-artifact-id: ${{ needs.build.outputs.artifact-id }}
    build-artifact-path: ${{ github.workspace }}

- name: Publish package tarball
  uses: hoverkraft-tech/ci-github-nodejs/actions/package/publish@<sha>
  with:
    package-tarball-artifact-id: ${{ steps.package.outputs.package-tarball-artifact-id }}
```

[Package creation](../../actions/package/create/README.md) detects npm, pnpm or
Yarn Classic from the project configuration and uses its native pack command.
It never installs dependencies, changes versions or runs lifecycle scripts.
Include files normally generated by `prepare` or `prepack` in the prepared build.

Configure [npm trusted publishing](../../actions/package/publish/README.md#npm-trusted-publishing)
for the caller repository and workflow, using a GitHub-hosted runner and
`id-token: write`. The caller also needs permission to read the artifact.
Use `dry-run: "true"` to validate publication before enabling uploads.
For registry tokens or GitHub Packages, follow the
[authentication guide](../../actions/package/publish/README.md#registry-tokens-and-github-packages).

When creating the GitHub release through `ci-github-publish`, attach the same
tarball from `steps.package.outputs.package-tarball-path`. Keep version planning,
source preparation and publication ordering in the caller workflow.
